# Forgeng

> Forgeng is an apprenticeship platform. Applicants apply, accepted students
> join a cohort, work through tasks, submit their work, and receive feedback
> from admins/mentors.

Forgeng is a TypeScript monorepo: a Next.js frontend and a NestJS + Prisma +
PostgreSQL backend. This file points AI tools at the project's primary
documentation. Technical/code-coupled docs live in the repo under `docs/`;
conceptual and process docs live in the GitHub wiki.

## Docs

- [Developer docs index](https://github.com/radcrew/forgeng/tree/main/docs): entry point for the in-repo technical documentation
- [Deployment guide](https://github.com/radcrew/forgeng/blob/main/docs/deployment.md): how the frontend (Vercel) and backend (Render + Postgres) deploy
- [Project README](https://github.com/radcrew/forgeng/blob/main/README.md): setup, prerequisites, and useful scripts

## Wiki

- [Product Overview](https://github.com/radcrew/forgeng/wiki/Product-Overview): what Forgeng is and the journeys it supports
- [Glossary](https://github.com/radcrew/forgeng/wiki/Glossary): domain terms (applicant, student, cohort, task, submission, feedback)
- [Contributing](https://github.com/radcrew/forgeng/wiki/Contributing): branch, commit, and PR workflow

## Optional

- [Roadmap](https://github.com/radcrew/forgeng/wiki/Roadmap): where the product is headed
